scope.analysis_scope: Custom — Sunday games kicking off before 2:00 p.m. ET
scope.kickoff_rule: Include Sunday games with scheduled kickoff strictly earlier than 2:00 p.m. ET

historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent completed regular-season games per player before the cutoff

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 5
historical_cutoff.game: Buffalo Bills at Los Angeles Rams

alternate_band_rule.core: Available alternate line with American odds between -350 and -150 inclusive, closest to -250; tie goes to more negative odds
alternate_band_rule.floor: Immediately lower available alternate threshold than CORE
alternate_band_rule.ceiling: Immediately higher available alternate threshold than CORE, regardless of HR
alternate_band_rule.hr: Historical HR calculated only from locked Stage 1 L10 observations; descriptive only
